gen-dafont-blockletter-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its curves open and its joins sturdy. Under Blockletter's squat, pencil-drawn display letters, it would read smoothly down a long page, a plain sans that never fusses.
gen-dafont-brusher-fs-rowan: Calligraphic, cord-heavy curves lead Brusher. Rowan follows in a serif with generous openings and a gentle thick-and-thin rhythm, which makes the romantic script feel grounded and friendly.
gen-dafont-burnstown-dam-work-sans: Work Sans has open c tips and a high mean line, set beneath a heading with hairline gaps and tall, geometric letters. Burnstown Dam delivers refinement in its closed shapes; Work Sans simply keeps reading easy.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-bespoke-sans: Bushcraft spaces its uniform-weight letters extra wide, with capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. And Bespoke Sans gives it open curves and a moderate lowercase height, so the page feels sharp rather than crowded.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-erode: Bushcraft draws every curve at a single line weight, with extra-wide spacing and barely distinct capitals up top. Erode's tall middle band and gently shifting strokes carry a dignified, steady rhythm for long reading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-familjen-grotesk: Wide, spaced-out, artistic letters with no weight shifts. Familjen Grotesk follows with tall lowercase and bowls left open on one side, a sans-serif that would keep a long passage lively and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-hind: Hind reads steadily, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and the c ends never curling inward. Hind would feel lost if Bushcraft's extra-wide display letters were shrunk small, so give that heading room.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-karma: Expressive, wide-spaced Bushcraft keeps its curves uniform and capitals low-key, while Karma brings sturdy hairlines and terminals clear of the stem. Make Karma's size generous enough to enjoy.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-quando: Expressive Bushcraft cuts every curve to one depth, like an engraver's tool, with extra-wide spacing. Quando counters with sparse spacing and a tall middle zone, serif traditions at home in words.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-instrument-sans: Expressive and artistic, Bushcraft holds one line weight with wide spacing and closed letters. Instrument Sans offers open, pincer-like c shapes and a plain sans steadiness for the text.
